name: TinySeed
claim: TinySeed says it helps B2B SaaS companies scale without traditional fundraising, losing control, or pressure to build a unicorn.
why_it_matters: Core ecosystem infrastructure for bootstrapped and non-unicorn SaaS founders.

name: TinySeed About
claim: TinySeed says it began because MicroConf-style capital-efficient startups had two choices: bootstrap or raise VC.
why_it_matters: Directly supports the thesis that the funding menu is incomplete.

name: Lighter Capital
claim: Lighter Capital offers revenue-based financing and non-dilutive growth capital for tech companies.
why_it_matters: Instrument/fund example for founders who need capital without traditional VC dilution.

name: Calm Company Fund
claim: Calm Company Fund describes shared earnings and SAFE-style structures for calm companies.
why_it_matters: Important instrument lineage from Earnest Capital / calm-company movement.

name: Basecamp Bootstrapped Profitable Proud
claim: Basecamp hosts a Bootstrapped, Profitable, and Proud series for profitable companies with over $1M revenue that did not take VC.
why_it_matters: Founder-facing language and proof tradition for non-VC success.

name: Acquire.com
claim: Acquire.com positions itself as a startup acquisition marketplace.

name: Searchfunder
claim: Searchfunder is a community/network for search funds and entrepreneurship through acquisition.

name: SV8
claim: SV8 says it invests in early-stage startups through an M&A lens and embeds acquisition thinking from day one.
why_it_matters: Directly relevant to Strategic Middle Ventures and acquisition-designed venture paths.

name: Tangle Venture Studio
claim: Tangle describes itself as acquiring profitable overlooked digital businesses, installing operators, and compounding value over decades.
why_it_matters: Useful bridge between SMVs, patient capital, and operator-led acquisition platforms.

name: SureSwift Capital
claim: SureSwift founder described acquiring 40+ bootstrapped businesses and running a SaaS portfolio.
why_it_matters: Shows acquirer/holding-company infrastructure for bootstrapped SaaS exits.

name: Venture Studio Index
claim: Venture Studio Index analyzed 1,700+ venture studio startups and exit patterns.
why_it_matters: Potential evidence base for Portfolio Capital classification.

name: BREIT Offering Terms
claim: BREIT terms state repurchases are generally limited to 2% of NAV per month and 5% per calendar quarter, with discretion to repurchase fewer or none.
why_it_matters: Supporting liquidity-design example only; not a core proof of Post-Unicorn Finance.
